mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever FEDFUNDS is observed, and the direction is determined by the change in FEDFUNDS (negative change = positive return signal).
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 300.0 indicates persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 300.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) are rising above their 3-month moving averages, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when HOUST and INDPRO are both above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market is tight, leading to wage pressures and inflation, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising RSAFS (residential fixed investment) indicates strong housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates continued economic strength.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when RSAFS is rising (month-over-month increase > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling below 3.5%, it signals a strong economy with tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong economy with tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 100 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates continued economic growth and corporate earnings strength.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when PAYEMS monthly change > 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
